rca of the issue: P0 root cause: NotesPhaseTabs (defined at line 1542 of NotesPage.jsx) references useRef on line 1545, but the react named-imports on line 1 previously only imported useState/useEffect/useCallback/useMemo. This threw 'useRef is not defined' as soon as the component tried to render — the error was caught by the ErrorBoundary which surfaced 'Something went wrong' on /session/:id/notes. Fix (already applied by main agent): added useRef to the react named-imports on line 1. Verified in-file: line 1 now reads `import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';` and the notes route now renders cleanly with the tabs mounted.
